# temper matrix

**27 features and 23 invariants on 2 subjects, at levels `unit` and `integration`.**

✅ 70 covered · ❌ 0 failing · ⬜ 0 missing · ☑️ 0 exempt · ⛔ 0 unsupported · ⏳ 0 unenforced

Each cell is one claim in `temper/` at one level. It is covered when a test that ran
at that level passed and none failed: a skip proves nothing, and a pass never hides
a failure. Regenerate with `temper matrix`.

✅ covered: a test proved it · ❌ failing · ⬜ missing: no passing test ·
☑️ exempt: excused, with proof · ⛔ unsupported: refused, with proof ·
⏳ unenforced: declared, not yet required · — not required

- <a id="inv-adapter.failure_never_passes"></a>**`adapter.failure_never_passes`** · safety · adapter — A test that fails, errors or panics never records pass.
- <a id="inv-adapter.level_from_runner"></a>**`adapter.level_from_runner`** · safety · adapter — The level a record carries comes only from TEMPER_LEVEL; no test can set it.
- <a id="inv-adapter.never_truncates"></a>**`adapter.never_truncates`** · safety · adapter — The adapter only appends, to a file unique to its process; it never truncates or removes evidence.
- <a id="inv-adapter.silent_without_runner"></a>**`adapter.silent_without_runner`** · safety · adapter — Without TEMPER_LEVEL and TEMPER_EVIDENCE the adapter records nothing and changes nothing.
- <a id="inv-adapter.skip_records_skip"></a>**`adapter.skip_records_skip`** · safety · adapter — A skipped test records skip.

- <a id="inv-declarations.ambiguous_answer_rejected"></a>**`declarations.ambiguous_answer_rejected`** · safety · honesty — A lattice answer map that does not say exactly one of supported: true and unsupported: true is an error; it is never read as supported.
- <a id="inv-matrix.exact_reference_only"></a>**`matrix.exact_reference_only`** · safety · honesty — Evidence credits only the item its reference names exactly; never by test name, id prefix, file path or level.
- <a id="inv-matrix.exemption_needs_passing_proof"></a>**`matrix.exemption_needs_passing_proof`** · safety · honesty — A cell is exempt only while a passing exempts record from the declared proven_by test exists; a covers record, another test, a skip or a failure leaves it missing or failing.
- <a id="inv-matrix.failure_beats_pass"></a>**`matrix.failure_beats_pass`** · safety · honesty — When several records claim one cell at one level, a failed or errored record makes the cell failing, whatever passed beside it. A pass never hides a failure.
- <a id="inv-matrix.no_evidence_is_an_error"></a>**`matrix.no_evidence_is_an_error`** · safety · honesty — With no evidence at any level and without --all-levels, temper matrix exits 2 and writes nothing. It never reports the committed statuses as the result of a run.
- <a id="inv-matrix.not_run_never_judged"></a>**`matrix.not_run_never_judged`** · safety · output — When another level ran, a level with no evidence keeps its committed statuses and never affects the exit code, unless --all-levels judges it.
- <a id="inv-matrix.output_deterministic"></a>**`matrix.output_deterministic`** · safety · output — The same declarations and evidence always produce the same bytes.
- <a id="inv-matrix.requires_any_one_level_proves_it"></a>**`matrix.requires_any_one_level_proves_it`** · safety · honesty — An invariant with requires_any is proven by a pass, or a proven exemption, at any one listed level; it is a gap once, per subject, only when no level is proven; and a failure at any level is still a gap.
- <a id="inv-matrix.scenario_needs_declaration"></a>**`matrix.scenario_needs_declaration`** · safety · honesty — A member of a scenario-covered lattice is credited only by evidence from a declared scenario that lists it, and a member no scenario lists is a gap before any test runs.
- <a id="inv-matrix.skip_never_covers"></a>**`matrix.skip_never_covers`** · safety · honesty — A skipped test never makes a cell covered, at any level.
- <a id="inv-matrix.stale_output_detected"></a>**`matrix.stale_output_detected`** · safety · output — matrix --check exits 3 whenever the committed statuses or MATRIX.md differ from what the evidence produces.
- <a id="inv-matrix.test_only_credits_nothing"></a>**`matrix.test_only_credits_nothing`** · safety · honesty — Evidence for a test-only subject credits no cell.
- <a id="inv-matrix.unknown_reference_fails"></a>**`matrix.unknown_reference_fails`** · safety · honesty — Evidence or a declaration that names an id Temper does not know is an error that exits 2; it is never ignored and never creates a row.
- <a id="inv-recipes.names_mean_one_thing"></a>**`recipes.names_mean_one_thing`** · safety · honesty — A command or fault name in a scenario resolves to exactly one definition; a pack never overrides or shadows a project definition.
- <a id="inv-scenarios.check_decides_its_own_claim"></a>**`scenarios.check_decides_its_own_claim`** · safety · honesty — Each check's outcome lands only on the reference that check decides; a failing check never fails another reference, and a passing one never covers another.
- <a id="inv-scenarios.faults_heal"></a>**`scenarios.faults_heal`** · safety · honesty — Every fault the runner injects is healed before the run ends, including when the run is interrupted; no container is left paused, stopped or disconnected.
- <a id="inv-scenarios.seed_replays"></a>**`scenarios.seed_replays`** · safety · honesty — The same scenario and seed draw the same fault sequence, targets and durations, so any run can be replayed.
- <a id="inv-scenarios.setup_failure_is_error"></a>**`scenarios.setup_failure_is_error`** · safety · honesty — A scenario that cannot run, because Docker is missing, a service never becomes ready or a setup step fails, records error for every reference it covers; never pass, fail or skip.
